lead_headline: Restaurant tracker goes completely quiet — zero new leads detected for the first time in weeks, while liquor license applications remain frozen for ninth straight business day.

restaurant.blurb: Zero new leads today — first day without detection activity in recent tracking window. Active pipeline holds at 315 total (165 openings, 150 closures).

liquor.blurb: Zero applications filed — ninth consecutive business day without activity confirms August's opening as mirror of July's final week, when drought first began. No new licenses detected across all categories (retail, tavern, restaurant, hotel). Weekly count frozen at zero for second straight week, down from three weeks prior when 8 applications marked last normal-volume period. Sustained freeze now spans 11 business days total since July 21, suggesting either state processing realignment extending batch cycles beyond monthly cadence or fundamental intake disruption. Next filing activity — whenever it emerges — will clarify whether this represents temporary administrative gap or permanent structural throttling of new license pipeline.

reputation.blurb: Zero mentions yesterday — first silent day in weeks extends this week's collapse to just 23 total citations across 9 sources, down 72% from prior week's 81. Instagram and Facebook tied at 6 mentions each (52% combined share), Denver Post added 4, Building Salt Lake and X contributed singles. Notable pickups included Alterra ski headquarters relocation coverage, Fire on the Mountain Central Park opening, Union Station preservation content. Week's 3.3 mentions/day average marks lowest sustained rate since early June and third consecutive week of decline from spring peak. Two-week total of 52 citations represents 55% drop from equivalent mid-July period. YTD count holds at 1,167 from 111 sources, but August opens with concerning momentum reversal — if pattern persists, monthly total could mark post-launch low.

subscriptions.blurb: Net flat yesterday (0 new, 0 canceled) — August's second day maintains MTD at +0 (+0.0/day), 90-day net at +100. Recent two-week pattern shows volatility stabilizing: prior seven days delivered +14 net despite mid-week churn (−14 on 7/21, +11 on 7/23); latest seven posted +20 net on smoother momentum (9 net on 7/28, 5 on 7/29, 6 on 8/1). Yesterday's zero-sum outcome — first flat day since July 25 — interrupts three-day gain streak but doesn't erase week's strong +20 performance. Longer view remains constructive: 90-day +100 net reflects sustained recovery from July's −16 finish (weakest month since March), and if August maintains even modest weekly gains, month could restore annual trajectory. YTD +216 (+1.0/day) unchanged.
